annotation.authors_or_issuer: Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros (PCM), Secretaría de Gobierno y Transformación Digital, Perú
key_provisions_or_claims: Regulation approved 9 September 2025 implementing Law No. 31814 on AI promotion.
Classifies AI uses by risk level; prohibits uses violating fundamental rights; high-risk uses under strict conditions.
Promotes transparency and human oversight; sets obligations for state and private sector.
Creates controlled test environments, innovation labs and support for MSMEs.
PCM's Secretariat of Government and Digital Transformation is national technical-normative authority.
annotation.summary_en: Peruvian government web page explaining the Regulation of Law No. 31814 on AI, approved 9 September 2025. It outlines risk-based classification, prohibited and high-risk uses, transparency and human oversight, sandboxes and MSME support, and the PCM's Secretariat of Government and Digital Transformation as governing authority.
annotation.title_clean: Conoce el Reglamento de la Ley de inteligencia artificial en el Perú
annotation.title_en: Learn about the Regulation of the Artificial Intelligence Law in Peru
